findings.claim: The dangling-reference scan backing acceptance criterion 3.3 ("no live frontend or workflow configuration references either deleted config file") cannot see extensionless files or anything outside `frontend/` and `.github/workflows`, so `frontend/Dockerfile` (present in the file tree) and root-level scripts are never checked for references to the deleted `postcss.config.js`/`tailwind.config.ts`.
findings.evidence: The scan is `rg --hidden -n 'tailwind\.config|postcss\.config' .github/workflows frontend --glob '*.{css,html,js,json,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx,yaml,yml}' ...` — the extension glob cannot match `frontend/Dockerfile` (no extension, listed in the packet's file_tree), and paths are limited to `.github/workflows` and `frontend`, excluding `scripts/*.sh|mjs`, `Dockerfile`, `run-dev.sh`, `start.sh`, and `bootstrap.sh` which operate on the frontend build. If any of these copy or reference the deleted config files, the break passes the criterion's own assertion undetected.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a targeted check for the known extensionless build entry points, e.g. `rg -n 'tailwind\.config|postcss\.config' frontend/Dockerfile Dockerfile scripts/ --glob '!**/node_modules/**'`, or drop the extension glob for the `frontend` scan and rely on the directory exclusions already present.
